author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In traditional coding, you spend your time in learning, thinking and typing/debugging. 

In vibe coding, the time for typing/debugging goes to zero, you can spend more time thinking and learning. 

Oddly that many fixes to address issues of vibe coding focus on the thinking part, spec driven development, better planning stage, no one seems to talk about you should spend more time in learning instead.
